items.quote: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
items.claim: The Israelites complained to Moses about being taken away to die in the wilderness

items.quote: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians?
items.claim: The Israelites told Moses in Egypt to let them serve the Egyptians

items.quote: For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
items.claim: It would have been better to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness
